story: On Monday, Tom goes to school with Anna.
On Wednesday, they play football in the park.
On Friday, Anna says, What's your favourite month?
Tom says, February! My birthday is in February.
On Sunday, Tom has a birthday cake.
Seven days in a week, and Tom is happy!
chant: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, too,
Thursday, Friday, school with you!
Saturday, Sunday, we play, play, play!
Seven days in a week, hooray!
January, February, March, April, May,
June, July, August, come and play!
September, October, November, too,
December! Twelve months for me and you!
commands: Say the days of the week.
Say the month of your birthday.
Count the days in a week.

story: Kim has a bag for lunch.
In the bag, there is an apple and an egg.
Kim gives Ben an orange.
Ben gives Kim a banana.
Kim says, Thank you! I have a banana now.
Ben says, Thank you! I have an orange now.
chant: A cat, a book, a ball, a hat,
An apple, an egg, I like that!
A banana, a lemon, one, two, three,
An orange, an ice cream, for you and me!
A cat, a book, an apple, an egg!

story: Lucy writes a sentence on the board.
Her sentence starts with a capital letter.
Her sentence ends with a full stop.
Tom has a capital letter. Lucy has a capital letter.
The word I has a capital letter, too.
The teacher says, Well done, Lucy!
chant: Big letter, big letter, at the start!
Full stop, full stop, at the end!
Tom, Anna, Sam and I,
A name has a capital letter, my friend!
Big letter, start! Full stop, end!
commands: Show me a capital letter for Anna.
Clap at the end of the sentence.

story: Sam and Grace have lunch in the kitchen.
Sam eats soup with a spoon.
Grace eats rice and chicken.
Sam drinks water from a glass.
Grace drinks milk from a cup.
They say, Thank you, Mum! Lunch is great!
chant: Eat, eat, eat your soup,
Eat your soup with a spoon!
Drink, drink, drink your milk,
Drink your juice from a cup!
Water in a glass, drink, drink, drink!
Soup with a spoon, eat, eat, eat!
commands: Show me how you eat soup.
Show me how you drink juice.
Say I eat with a spoon.
Say I drink milk from a glass.

story: There is a big clock on the kitchen wall.
Ben looks at the clock. He can play now!
Ben plays football for one hour.
Then he reads a book for fifteen minutes.
Grace paints for fifty minutes. Five, fifteen, fifty!
Ben and Grace are happy. Well done!
chant: Five, fifteen, fifty, say them with me!
Five, fifteen, fifty, one, two, three!
A clock on the wall, a clock on the wall,
One hour, one hour, play with a ball!
Fifteen minutes, fifty minutes, too,
One hour of fun for me and you!

story: Tom has a ball. The ball is red.
Anna has a kite. The kite is blue.
Sam has a cat. The cat is small.
The cat sits in a box.
The box is big. The cat is happy.
chant: I have a ball. The ball is red.
I have a kite. The kite is blue.
I have a cat. The cat is small.
I have a box. The box is new!

story: Kim goes to school at eight o'clock.
On Monday, she has an English lesson.
On Friday, she plays tennis at four o'clock.
Her birthday is in May.
In December, she goes to the beach with her family.
Kim is happy on Sunday, at home with Grandma.
chant: At eight o'clock, at eight o'clock,
On Monday, on Friday, on Sunday, too!
In May, in June, in July, hooray!
At for the clock, on for the day,
In for the month, let's say it, hooray!

story: Lucy can swim in the sea.
Her brother Ben can jump.
Grandpa can ride a bike.
The bird can fly. The fish can swim.
Lucy says, I can sing! Listen!
Lucy, Ben and Grandpa are happy at the beach.
chant: She can swim, she can swim,
He can jump, he can jump,
I can run, I can run,
Birds can fly, birds can fly,
We can sing, we can sing!
commands: Say my friend can ride a bike.

story: I am Alex. I am happy today.
This is my sister, Eva. She is seven.
This is my brother, Nick. He is ten.
We are in the park with my family.
Nick is sad. His kite is in a tree.
Now Nick is happy. We are happy, too!
chant: I am happy, I am happy,
He is happy, she is happy,
We are happy, they are happy,
You are my friend, you are my friend!
I am, he is, she is, they are!
